match: US tightens export rules on advanced AI chips to China

response.event_summary: US imposes license requirements on exports of high-end AI accelerators to China, affecting NVIDIA and AMD; TSMC may see lower advanced-node orders.

evidence.quote: The US Commerce Department announced new export restrictions on advanced AI accelerators to China
The rules require licenses for shipments of high-end data-center GPUs made by NVIDIA and AMD.
NVIDIA could lose a meaningful share of its data-center revenue from Chinese customers
AMD said it was reviewing the impact of the new rules on its MI-series accelerators.
TSMC, which manufactures the affected chips, may see lower order volumes for advanced nodes

uncertainties: Magnitude of revenue impact is not quantified in the article.
response.rationale: Explicit regulatory restriction naming the companies; analyst comment indicates revenue risk.

note: Synthetic demo data for ImpactLens. Not real financial data.
